Part III

Read the following passage and do the tasks below (1.4 points)

My Close Friend Nam

My close friend is Nam. Nam is a very loving and sporty boy. He is tall and has bright eyes. Nam loves sports; he plays badminton and cycles to school every day. At the weekend, he always does his homework before class. He is also very helpful. Nam usually helps some old people near his house by reading books or cleaning their gardens.

Today, Nam is helping our class with the class yearbook project. Right now, Nam is sitting at a desk with a sheet of paper. He is sticking a happy group photo of us on it. After that, he is going to decorate the page with colorful drawings. Everyone loves Nam because he is always kind and makes people laugh by telling clever jokes.

MINI REVIEW - TỔNG HỢP KIẾN THỨC BÀI HỌC

Ghi nhớ từ vựng & cấu trúc trọng tâm để chuẩn bị cho kỳ thi sắp tới

Key Vocabulary (Từ vựng quan trọng)

  • yearbook (n): kỷ yếu lớp
  • description (n): sự mô tả
  • sporty (adj): năng động, yêu thể thao
  • decorate (v): trang trí

Core Grammar Structures (Cấu trúc cốt lõi)

  • 1. Hỏi ngoại hình:
    What + do/does + S + look like? → S + is tall/short...
  • 2. Hỏi tính cách:
    What + is/are + S + like? → S + is kind/active/loving...
  • 3. Thì Hiện tại tiếp diễn:
    S + am/is/are + V-ing (Diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra right now / at present).
